rejectedRuns.reason: Android gave an inverted rectangle for an off-screen EditText; the initial driver accepted it and tapped a source radio instead.
rejectedRuns.fix: Require positive height and fully enclosed viewport bounds, then assert entered text and focus before dispatch.

rejectedRuns.reason: The isolated form gallery has no production keyboard-avoiding parent; dispatch scrolling must dismiss its IME.
rejectedRuns.fix: Dismiss IME for the isolated callback check. Verify IME-visible Save separately in the actual nested ZoneProfileScreen editor.

rejectedRuns.reason: An extra Android Back after an already dismissed IME closed the gallery client; foregrounding it raised a multiple-linking development warning.
rejectedRuns.fix: Remove redundant Back; cold-start only once, allow boot to settle, verify no development overlay, then resume. Immediate duplicate launch during boot was also rejected. No warning suppression or production navigation change.

rejectedRuns.reason: A development linking overlay reappeared during an Android density/font transition in the keyboard run; the run was rejected and settings restored.
rejectedRuns.fix: Cold-stop before geometry changes and launch one settled root per case. Existing overlay-free matrix remains accepted; keyboard checks are rerun.

rejectedRuns.reason: Android input text, Back and screencap stalled until the development client was force-stopped; ADB shell/boot remained responsive.
rejectedRuns.fix: Record the stalled frame as rejected, reboot the owned emulator, require numeric IME visible before entering text, and rerun.

rejectedRuns.reason: Android did not provide topResumedActivity during service activation; the driver raised StopIteration after both reduced-motion captures. Settings and notification permission were restored.
rejectedRuns.fix: Accept either Android resumed-activity field and allow service recovery after the hierarchy dump. Retain completed reduced-motion evidence and resume TalkBack review.

rejectedRuns.reason: The tutorial Back heuristic left the client on the launcher; the missing target was a rejected driver run. All service, animation and permission settings were restored.
rejectedRuns.fix: Activate TalkBack before launching one gallery root; remove the heuristic Back. Retain reviewed source-choice selection and reduced-motion captures; resume the threshold touch capture.

rejectedRuns.reason: One-finger synthetic swipes did not scroll the active TalkBack form; no prior result action was reached.
rejectedRuns.fix: Position the existing result with TalkBack off, then activate it without a Back heuristic. Capture actual UI; explicitly leave target focus retention and spoken behavior unverified.
